title: Isaiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 34
description: Ten questions on Isaiah 34: Yahweh's anger against the nations, the sword on Edom, and the land left to wild creatures.

questions.text: Against whom is Yahweh enraged at the start of this chapter?
questions.explanation: The nations are called to hear, for Yahweh is enraged against all the nations and angry with all their armies.

answers.text: Against the kings of the east
Against all the nations and their armies
Against the cities of the coast

questions.text: Like what will the sky be rolled up?
questions.explanation: The sky will be rolled up like a scroll, and all its armies will fade away as a leaf fades from a vine or a fig tree.

answers.text: Like a wave of the sea

questions.text: On which land will Yahweh's sword come down for judgment?
questions.explanation: The sword that has drunk its fill in the sky will come down on Edom, on the people of his curse, for judgment.

questions.text: In which city does Yahweh have a sacrifice?
questions.explanation: Yahweh has a sacrifice in Bozrah, and a great slaughter in the land of Edom.

questions.text: What does verse 8 call Yahweh's day?
questions.explanation: Yahweh has a day of vengeance, a year of recompense for the cause of Zion.

answers.text: A day of vengeance for the cause of Zion
A day of darkness and thick gloominess
A day of trumpet blasts and loud alarm
A day of rest for the whole weary earth

questions.text: Into what will the streams of the land be turned?
questions.explanation: Its streams will be turned into pitch, its dust into sulfur, and its land will become burning pitch.

questions.text: How long will the smoke of the land go up?
questions.explanation: It won't be quenched night nor day; its smoke will go up forever, and from generation to generation it will lie waste.

questions.text: Which creatures will possess the land, according to verse 11?
questions.explanation: The pelican and the porcupine will possess it, and the owl and the raven will dwell in it.

answers.text: The lion and the bear from the forest
The locust and the caterpillar in swarms
The serpent and the scorpion of the desert
The pelican and the porcupine, the owl and the raven

questions.text: What will come up in its palaces?
questions.explanation: Thorns will come up in its palaces, nettles and thistles in its fortresses, and it will be a habitation of jackals.

questions.text: How has the land been divided to the creatures that will possess it?
questions.explanation: He has cast the lot for them, and his hand has divided it to them with a measuring line; they will possess it forever.

answers.text: By the word of the king
By the counsel of the elders
By lot and with a measuring line
By the strength of each creature
